newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Saztec to offer 300 mln pesos worth bonds.
newsitem.headline: Saztec to offer 300 mln pesos worth bonds.

text.p: Software programmer Saztec Philippines Inc said on Tuesday its board had approved the offering of convertible bonds worth up to 300 million pesos.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange it would also issue 16 million underlying shares to cover the convertible bonds. The company set the conversion price of up to 19 pesos per share.
Details of the convertible bonds are still being worked out.
